archetypes.name: Azorius Forecast
archetypes.plan: Develop evasive creatures, gain repeatable value from forecast, and use Azorius Guildmage to control activated abilities and combat.

archetypes.name: Orzhov Haunt
archetypes.plan: Trade creatures for value, attach haunt cards to likely casualties, and use Orzhov Guildmage to win a long attrition game.

archetypes.name: Boros Tempo
archetypes.plan: Build a disciplined creature curve, grant haste to maintain pressure, and use first strike to control combat.

archetypes.name: Selesnya Tokens
archetypes.plan: Create a wide Saproling board, convoke larger spells ahead of curve, and finish with a team-wide boost.

archetypes.name: Dimir Control
archetypes.plan: Trade resources early, then use repeatable card draw and discard to dominate a long game.

archetypes.name: Izzet Replicate
archetypes.plan: Control the board with cheap spells, then spend spare mana on replicate and Izzet Guildmage copies for repeated value.

archetypes.name: Simic Graft
archetypes.plan: Build creatures carrying +1/+1 counters, move those counters to the threats that need them, and exploit graft triggers as the board grows.

archetypes.name: Rakdos Hellbent
archetypes.plan: Empty the hand through efficient threats and removal, turn on hellbent rewards, and convert spare cards or creatures into damage.

archetypes.name: Golgari Graveyard
archetypes.plan: Fill the graveyard through trades and dredge, recur the best creatures, and grow the threats that remain.

archetypes.name: Gruul Bloodthirst
archetypes.plan: Deal combat damage early, then cast bloodthirst creatures with counters and use Gruul Guildmage to turn excess mana into pressure.
